title: Universal 10/10 Master Production Certification & Release Freeze (Platform-Wide 68-Route Real-DOM Audit & Cryptographic Seal)

# DIR-034: Universal 10/10 Master Production Certification & Release Freeze

## 1. Executive Context & Objectives
This is the ultimate capstone release directive for the ResumePilotAI platform. It mandates the comprehensive execution of the 10/10 Production Certification Protocol across all 68 application routes, verifying zero regressions, zero broken controls, zero console errors, full WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, and complete feature parity.

Upon successful completion of all preceding directives (DIR-001 through DIR-033 and DIR-035 through DIR-040), this directive produces the cryptographic verification bundle, generates the Production Certification Seal, and locks the release baseline.

## 2. Master Verification Protocol
1. **Full Platform Real-DOM Crawl**:
   - Crawl all 68 routes across Candidate, Recruiter, Enterprise, Admin, and Public surfaces.
   - Click and verify every interactive button, tab, modal, dropdown, and form control.
   - Verify zero 404s, zero uncaught JavaScript exceptions, and zero broken image assets.

2. **Performance & Core Web Vitals Audit**:
   - Run automated Lighthouse audits on representative routes: Landing, Candidate Dashboard, Resume Builder, Recruiter ATS, Enterprise Console, Admin Settings.
   - Enforce standards: FCP < 1.5s, LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.05, FID < 100ms.

3. **Security & Data Isolation Audit**:
   - Verify zero secret credential leakage across all frontend bundles and network requests.
   - Verify multi-tenant isolation and strict RBAC guards across all API routes.
   - Confirm CSRF protection, secure cookie flags, and Content Security Policy headers.

4. **Cryptographic Release Artifact**:
   - Compute SHA-256 hashes of all certified source modules and deployment bundles.
   - Generate production certification audit report test-results/MASTER_PRODUCTION_CERTIFICATION.json.

## 3. Acceptance Criteria
1. 100% of 68 routes crawl successfully with zero broken interactive controls or dead links.
2. Core Web Vitals meet performance targets (CLS < 0.05, FCP < 1.5s) on both mobile and desktop.
3. Zero console errors, warnings, or uncaught promise rejections during full crawl.
4. WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance confirmed across all portal surfaces.
5. All 40 directives verified in status 'APPROVED_FROZEN' or 'VERIFIED_10_10'.
6. Master Production Certification report generated with cryptographic checksums.

## 4. Strict Invariants
1. Do not certify production release if any P0 or P1 directive remains unverified.
2. No mock or simulated evidence may be accepted for final certification.
3. All production code must be committed cleanly to the designated release branch.
4. Zero security vulnerabilities or plain-text secrets in the repository.
